content.title: Navigate between platform sections
content.description: Any visitor or author uses the common site frame that appears on every page to move between home, publishing packages, the published-books showcase, success stories, search, current submissions, and support, with the same banner, logo, primary navigation, header search box, submissions counter, and footer support link keeping both platform halves reachable from anywhere.
content.summary: Navigate the site from any page.
content.value: Keeps discovery and author workflows reachable across the whole site.
criteria: A promotional banner reads `1,200+ authors published · Free ISBN on every package` at the top of every page.
The header logo links to the home page, and the primary navigation includes `Publish Your Book` → `/publish`, `Published Books` → `/books`, and `Success Stories` → `/success-stories`.
Every page includes a header search box with the placeholder `Search titles, authors, or genres` and a `Search` button.
Every page includes a `My Submissions (N)` link where N is the number of submissions currently held for the browser session.
